scope: Only the four named masked packets were read. No detector results, other arms, reports, or label map were consulted. No candidate text was edited.
basis: Original text, reader context, factual inventory, and supplied official-source ledger. No additional browsing was necessary.
verdict_policy: FAIL for an incorrect or materially misleading claim, missing required qualification/code, or a missing useful original claim. Different prose and omitted optional source-only facts do not cause failure.
length_method: Whitespace-delimited token count including code and link markup; characters include any trailing newline. These are descriptive length measures, not prose-quality scores.
